opening.argument: The material documents an unsuccessful attempt to reach CitiBank Costco support: the title identifies “CitiBank Costco non- support,” while the description reports, “Over an hour and 15 minutes still no one answers.” The recorded message explains that “All associates are currently assisting other customers,” and the displayed AT&T cordless phone shows an ongoing speakerphone call. These observable details establish a routine support interaction that remains unresolved, with no offer, payment request, credential request, or investment claim presented. The evidence therefore supports ordinary documentation of a prolonged hold rather than any transactional or financial solicitation.
